title: Supply-chain graph: openCypher queries and a tenant-safe graph tool
scenario: Acme Foods asks relationship questions vector search answers badly. Two tenants' supply chains live in one Neptune Analytics graph loaded from openCypher CSV files. Write five openCypher queries (multi-hop, variable-length, aggregation) and the agent tool that runs named templates through ExecuteQuery with the tenant bound from the verified token.
task: Write five parameterized openCypher queries with every node scoped to $tenant_id
Statically check templates for unscoped node patterns
Build ExecuteQuery requests from named templates and validated arguments only
Parse the payload, cap rows, set a query timeout
acceptance: Queries return the expected rows for both tenants, even with planted cross-tenant edges
The tool refuses model-supplied query text and tenant ids
Valid ExecuteQuery requests (Stubber) and row truncation
